task_description.overview: Create a global map displaying a single beachball symbol from a given moment tensor parameter list at a specified coordinate.
steps: Configure a PlateCarree projection centered on a chosen longitude (e.g., 142.0°).
Initialize a world map with coastline and gridlines, set extent to global (-180 to 180, -90 to 90).
Transform the given event lon/lat coordinate to plot projection coordinates.
Define the moment tensor list [m_rr, m_tt, m_pp, m_rt, m_rp, m_tp].
Generate a beachball symbol using obspy.imaging.beachball.beach with the moment tensor list and projection coordinates.
Add the beachball to the map and display the figure.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Set up a global PlateCarree map centered at {central_longitude}°. Plot coastlines and gridlines for extent [-180,180,-90,90]. Transform the event location ({event_location.lon},{event_location.lat}) to map projection coordinates. Use the moment tensor {moment_tensor_list} and projected position to draw a beachball at the map. 
 Note: 1) Save the beachball plot to {result_plot}.
